SinkBathroomN2: ^A sink laced with hairline cracks and a mineral-crusted faucet. A dried-out bar of soap sits fused to its dish.
On: ^Upon turning on the sink, a light rumble can be heard from the pipes before any water is produced.
^The initial stream is broken apart by sputters from the rusted innerworkings, but eventually a consistent flow is formed.
Closer: ^Strangely, you notice what appears to be splotches of dried blood.
